correctness.rationale: Differentiation yields exact c=C/(uv)[PQ-s(a v^{-s}+b u^{-s})], with the displayed algebraic nonnegative lower bound under s(a+b)<=1. Necessity follows from c(1,1)=1-s(a+b), which is negative on a neighborhood for forbidden weights. Margins, boundary continuity and positivity establish a genuine copula for all real admissible parameters. The logarithmic conditional corner limits produce (1-e^{-b},1-e^{-a}) at s=1 and both zero otherwise; inversion yields the exact envelope. The diagonal depends only on a+b, while the density expansion near (1,1) yields cubic upper-right decay exactly on the sharp boundary. An independently executed 70-digit numerical checker passed all indicated finite cross-checks. No simulation is used to prove the universal statement.

originality.rationale: The 2025/2026 Papadopoulos full text defines the symmetric Stingray and gives the equal opposite-tail endpoints, but expressly leaves one-sided asymmetry open (preprint Section 2.3, Section 3.6). The 2023 Chesneau PVP2 paper (Proposition 3.2) covers only equal coefficients; its specific Khoudraji asymmetrization ties coefficient and exponent choices and does not imply independently variable equal-power weights. Chesneau's 2023 Axioms IP copula covers one directional face, not the two-direction full simplex. The accepted exact triangular two-weight validity and nonlinear opposite-tail image are a new combined classification relative to inspected material. Searches of published records, equivalent exponent language, and the inspected published scientific claims yielded no covering result; scholarly priority beyond those inspections remains uncertain.
residual_risks: A 2024 Bull CompAMa source remained abstract-only; a nonobvious encompassing general theorem in its full text would affect priority and should be checked independently.
Semantic searching and inspected scientific coverage do not establish uniqueness or exclude unindexed published work.
This is a theoretical copula construction; finite-sample risk-model performance and estimation identifiability are not proved.

value.rationale: The motivating 2025/2026 paper expressly suggests analyzing an asymmetric form to model negative-dependence extremes. The result supplies an exact feasible parameter simplex, complete attainable two-tail region with explicit inverse calibration, and a structural warning: identical full diagonal behavior can hide different directional extreme-risk probabilities. The cubic upper-right transition supplies a sharp boundary diagnostic. These results answer an explicit model-design gap rather than recomputing a known one-parameter concordance table; no downstream application is claimed without evidence.
